the development and application of an approach to nuclear physics based on the spontaneously chiral symmetry of QCD and the resulting effective field theory of pions and nucleons.

the spontaneous chiral symmetry breaking in QCD is the underlying mechanism for the emergence of nucleons and nuclear forces.

the spontaneous breaking of chiral symmetry at low energy is the fundamental mechanism underlying nuclear many-body systems.
the spontaneous breakdown of chiral symmetry plays a crucial role in determining the properties of nuclear matter.
